描述_EN: it takes the form of a mythical one-horned beast called 'xiniu'. many mirrors had links with the chinese mystical philosophy of taoism. the meaning of the allusion being that miracles can be brought into being by mental activity alone. this beautiful mirror stand seems to combine a practical use perhaps for a lady of leisure, with taoist symbolism. this form of mirror stand represents the classical allusion 'the xiniu longs for the moon', with the mirror being the moon. mirrors in china are associated with ceremonial rites and magic and mysticism, as well as with ordinary cosmetic purposes.
描述_ZN: 它采用了神话中的独角兽的形式，称为 "西牛"。 许多镜子都与中国的神秘主义哲学--道教有联系。 这个典故的意思是，奇迹可以仅仅通过精神活动来实现。 这个美丽的镜架似乎结合了一个实用的用途，也许是一个休闲的女士，和道教的象征意义。 这种形式的镜架代表了经典的典故'西牛贺岁'，镜子就是月亮。 中国的镜子与仪式、魔法和神秘主义有关，也与普通的化妆用途有关。
